notes: All three substantive classifications are correct for both skill versions. The two baseline failures concern explicit, traceable source evidence, not accepting false findings.

Ten of twelve assertions do not discriminate between versions. This is a small synthetic suite with one run per version per scenario; it does not establish statistical superiority or robustness on real PRs.
Reported standard deviation is across the three different scenarios, not repeated samples of the same prompt.
Timing, token, tool-call and error metrics were not exposed by executor notifications and are unavailable, not zero.
Skill description, goal and shared-rubric routing were aligned after execution; the tested verification gate and decision criteria were unchanged.
The baseline snapshot is archived as ../baseline.md to avoid a nested discoverable SKILL.md inside the plugin.
